## Abstract

The Information Architecture domain encompasses decisions related to data modeling standards, information governance policies, API design principles, data exchange formats, and knowledge management strategies. This domain ensures consistent, secure, and efficient handling of information assets across the enterprise.

Information architecture decisions directly impact data quality, integration capabilities, analytics effectiveness, and regulatory compliance for data management practices.
